CustomField.description: Sets routing priority 1 = emergency queue, 2 = priority queue, 3 = normal queue.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( TEXT(Priority) = 'Emergency', CONTAINS(TEXT(Account.Support_Priority_Tier__c),'Principal'), TEXT(Severity__c) = '1 - Critical: affects many accounts that can not do business.', TEXT(Severity__c) = '2 - High: affects one account that can not do business.', CONTAINS(Subject, "emergency"), CONTAINS(Subject, "Emergency"), CONTAINS(Subject, "EMERGENCY"), CONTAINS(Subject, "P1"), CONTAINS(Subject, "p1"), CONTAINS(Subject, "critical"), CONTAINS(Subject, "Critical"), CONTAINS(Subject, "CRITICAL") ), "1", IF( OR( TEXT(Severity__c) = '3 - Medium: affects many accounts, but not a showstopper.', CONTAINS(Subject, "urgent"), CONTAINS(Subject, "Urgent"), CONTAINS(Subject, "URGENT"), CONTAINS(Support_Level__c, "White"), CONTAINS(TEXT(Account.Support_Priority_Tier__c),'White')), "2", "3") )
CustomField.label: Routing Priority
